subject: Re: Kickoff: CamP Zip-NeRF - M2 status: 360 repro green, CamP earns its keep
body:
Status.

M1 recap: unit tests green, Blender repro matched published PSNR within 0.1 dB. M2: the Mip-NeRF 360 repro finished Sunday - we're within noise on 6 of 7 scenes, one (bicycle) is 0.3 dB under and Yusuf suspects a train-schedule difference; rerunning with the release's exact config.

CamP ablation on Katya's synthetic scenes is the interesting bit: with clean poses, CamP preconditioning changes nothing (expected). At synthetic pose noise matching what we measured from phone-capture COLMAP runs, Zip-NeRF alone drops 4-6 dB PSNR; with CamP the drop is 0.8-1.4 dB. That's the product story in one chart - casual capture is unusable without pose refinement and fine with it.

Risks for M3: training cost. ~14 A100-hours per scene at our settings is fine for a quality reference, not for an ingestion product. The report will say that plainly: the product track needs a distillation/acceleration phase before any customer-facing latency promise. Also titan contention did bite twice; thanks Deshawn for the vulcan bridge.

Milan
